from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationNode(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single paper in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being parsed")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] | None = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers in the collection that this paper references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated data for all provided papers."""
    papers: list[CitationNode]
